notes: al-Faqih's statement of his routes («طرق») to Ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti with no saying (rule 11): read as the routes the text gives; each route ends at the Bazanti
The convergence on أحمد بن محمّد ابن عيسى is taken from «جميعا» in «والحميريّ جميعا عن ...»; the father's route is written as the text states it
The second statement («ورويته عن أبي ... ماجيلويه») is a separate route; «أبي» and «البزنطي» recur and are given by occurrence
